correctness.rationale: The unique smooth conic must be preserved. Its plane stabilizer restricts faithfully to it (four distinct conic points in general position determine a projectivity) and lifts every Mobius automorphism via the quadratic embedding. Substituting [2uv:v²−u²:v²+u²] in the six line forms gives six distinct marked pairs, so preserving the arrangement is exactly preserving {0,∞,1,−1}. The anharmonic orbit of −1 consists of −1, 2, and 1/2, so exactly 24/3=8 permutations lift. The written R and S induce (u−v:u+v) and (−u:v), respectively, and generate the eight symmetries. At each marked point the three secants and the conic tangent are distinct. The opposite chords meet at [0:0:1], [1:1:0], and [1:−1:0], all off the conic; the other twelve chord pairs meet at the four marked points. This accounts for all singularities.
residual_risks: No packaged verifier was executed. The incidences and group were checked symbolically; the packaged line-permutation loop itself does not test preservation of the conic form, which follows directly from the displayed matrices.
